chief_complaint: Advanced chronic kidney disease (stage 4) with pending kidney transplantation and multiple comorbidities
history_of_present_illness: The patient has a long-standing history of type 2 diabetes diagnosed in 1947, which has progressed to diabetic kidney disease with sequential CKD stages 2, 3, and now stage 4 (onset 1974). Proteinuria and microalbuminuria were documented in the early 1970s. He also has metabolic syndrome, hypertriglyceridemia, osteoporosis, and non‑proliferative diabetic retinopathy. Prostate neoplasm (carcinoma in situ) was identified in 1976 and is being managed with hormonal/chemotherapy agents not reflected in the current medication list. He is awaiting kidney transplantation. Psychosocial stressors—including social isolation, intimate‑partner abuse, and chronic stress—are active. Current therapy is limited to insulin and an opioid/acetaminophen combination, suggesting significant gaps in guideline‑directed care.
